title: Faucet (kitchen or bathroom tap)

parts.label: Faucet
parts.looks: Spout and one or two handles on the sink deck.
parts.normal: No drip from the spout or base when off.
parts.abnormal: Drip from the spout tip (usually cartridge or seats) or water at the base or under the handle (usually O-rings).

parts.label: Aerator
parts.looks: The screen at the tip of the spout.

faults.name: Worn cartridge or seat
faults.evidence: Drops forming at the spout tip with the handle off.

faults.name: Worn O-ring
faults.evidence: Water around the base or under the handle, seen from below with light.

may: Close the shut-off valves under the sink (water only).
Use the Light button for the underside.

tour.open: Show me the whole faucet from about half a metre.

checkpoints.hint: Tilt up to the underside of the spout and the handle base. Tap Light if it is dark.
